Late summer in Texas is no joke. The ground is hard, the schedule is full, and your horse has been working.

Most performance horses across DFW are carrying more tension right now than their owners realize. They're not lame. They're not done. They're just not quite right — and that gap costs you in the pen.

Dr. Leo is scheduling across North Texas. Mobile. We come to your barn.

Don't wait until something goes wrong to get your horse checked.

Book now — shortgochiro.com or (406) 799-3369.
